story_type: NASA resource analyst rides the back seat of an F/A-18, cockpit camera
hook: She tracks NASA's budget. Today the horizon stood on its side.
narration: She tracks money and resources for NASA. Today she rode in a fighter jet that rolled onto its side.
Nicole Fiorentino is a senior resource analyst at NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California.
The ride was a reward. NASA's Administrator set up these flights to thank people for their work.
The F/A-18 took off from Edwards and climbed out over the desert.
Riders wear a G suit. In tight turns it inflates around the legs and stomach and pushes blood back toward the brain.
Then the whole world tipped sideways.
[short pause] After they landed, she put her hands to her face.
outcome: The F/A-18 landed safely at Edwards, and Nicole Fiorentino climbed down the ladder on her own.
title: Budget analyst rides a NASA F/A-18
description:
On Oct. 8, 2026, NASA senior resource analyst Nicole Fiorentino rode in the back seat of an F/A-18 at NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, as part of the agency's employee incentive flights.
